items.value: CAUTION, INGREDIENT UNIDENTIFIED
THE COOKING PROCESS IS DISTURBED!
What do you know, you stupid piece of iron?
Don't bother me, you idiot!
WELL DONE
KEEP IT UP
I DON'T EVEN KNOW WHAT YOU ARE DOING
ACCEPTED. THE ADVENTURERS LICEVS
Oh-oh-oh, who would talk, a piece of iron
Shut up! The last thing we need here is you!
Phew, looks like we're done...
I think so. I'll wake up Gvinka now.
Hmm, is that really the Prancing Pony? Shouldn't it glow orange?
You don't understand much! Come on, drink! I have everything according to the prescription!
Wow! That's such a cool beard! Even cooler than my mom's! And dad's! I need to run over to my family and show it off, haha!
Oh... or... or just walk away slowly... and still show off...
THIS WAS NOT "PRANCE PONY." IT WAS "UNKNOWN ELIXIR." PLEASE TAKE THE CORRECT POTION.
Oh, that's just what I needed! Thank you! Now I'm off to run!
Granny, are you still sure it was a prancing pony?
I think I got something mixed up. Oh, old age is no joy.
Grandma, don't be upset, it happens to everyone!
Oh, I don't know, I don't know... I'll sit here for a while, grandson, and think, maybe I made a mistake. Go to your room and get some sleep. Good night.

It's been a good day. Not only did I shake off the blues, but I also helped the kids out. I helped Owl pick jam, found Gvinka a broom and helped her with the cleaning... Just think – I've done so little, and yet I feel better than I did after the battle with the Dark Lord.

At first, I thought everything would be as dreary here as in the Capital, including this storm I'd flown through. Just think—dragons fly here once every two months, and it's precisely on that "time" that such a downpour occurs.
But overall... I feel better already. Just think, I haven't been here for over twenty years, and yet I still feel like a child. It's like home, you can't say anything else.
I hope I can return to work later. The Kingdom still needs me.
